The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (2.00%) for the intermeeting period.
Domestic economic activity has continued on a recovering trend thanks to the progress of global economic situation.
The upward trend of real estate prices has slowed.

Financial market price variables such as exchange rates and stock prices have shown generally stable movements but their volatility heightened somewhat at one stage under the influence of international financial market unrest.
Exports and consumption have continued to improve.
The mortgage lending has grown on a similar scale to last month.
There still, however, remains uncertainty as to the economic growth path.
Consumer price inflation has accelerated somewhat, but seems likely to remain generally stable.
Looking ahead, the Committee will maintain the accommodative policy stance for the time being with an emphasis on sustaining the recovery of business activity.
